hook_main: Nine years making financial operations feel simple
hook_accent: now scaling one system across many products.
positioning: Product designer focused on B2B financial products, where a single unclear screen becomes a support ticket and a lost payment. I turn dense business rules into flows people trust, and I build the systems that keep many products coherent as teams grow.

why_rows.label: Payments, already my day job
why_rows.text: Five years designing reconciliation and billing for 3,000 companies, the same operational problems Acme solves for small merchants.

why_rows.label: One system for many products
why_rows.text: Led a design system adopted by 4 products, with shared tokens, documentation and a contribution model.

why_rows.label: Decisions backed by numbers
why_rows.text: Redesigned an e-commerce checkout and cut abandonment by 12%, measured in an A/B test.

why_rows.label: Senior IC who raises the bar
why_rows.text: Runs critiques and pairs with juniors without leaving the craft: strategy, flows and final pixels.

experience.desc: Owns the reconciliation experience for 3,000 business clients and leads the design system shared by 4 products.
Checkout and account area for an e-commerce with 1 million orders a month; checkout redesign cut abandonment by 12%.
